FileMaker plugin

fm-dc

Gives agents a controlled engineering path into FileMaker projects.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The broad FileMaker lane

fm-dc packages the domain knowledge and mechanisms needed to inspect, change, verify, and recover FileMaker work across local and hosted systems.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Save-as-XML and DDR parsing for inspectable project structure
  • Script, calculation, schema, and XML authoring guidance
  • ProofKit, Data API, OData, Admin API, and Otto connection routing
  • Patch generation with verification, backups, and rollback
  • Project scaffolding, status reporting, and change records

The handoff

01Projectbaseline
02Agentproposes
03Patchapplies
04Verifierchecks
05Recordcaptures

Why it matters

FileMaker becomes inspectable work

The plugin gives agents explicit channels for source, data, schema, server state, and UI evidence. Changes can move through the same factory loop as conventional code while retaining FileMaker-specific backup and rollback boundaries.
